questions.prompt: How does the centre organise its help?
options: It sends every visitor to the same training course.
It brings several kinds of support together locally.
It provides job advice through a national website.
It asks visitors to contact employers before coming.
questions.explanationZh: 中心把简历、职业、心理健康和住房支持放到同一地点，不是统一培训或纯网络服务。

questions.prompt: What are the young visitors seeking help with?
options: Preparing to enter work and dealing with related needs.
Choosing staff for the centre and planning its services.
Opening a new centre and finding local partners.
Providing training for employers across the country.
questions.explanationZh: 青年需要就业准备及相关支持；他们不是负责建立中心、聘用中心人员或培训雇主的机构。

questions.prompt: Which statement describes the wider plan?
options: Opening 360 centres in Scotland during the next year.
Offering three years of training to 360 young people.
Expanding hubs to over 360 areas across Great Britain in three years.
Connecting 360 employers with one centre over three years.
questions.explanationZh: 360多指地区数，三年指扩展计划时间，范围为大不列颠。
